commit.message:
Make freshness visible and controllable

The readout was already live but gave no way to tell how live, and no way to
force a new reading.

- header shows a ticking "updated Ns ago" instead of a static UTC stamp
- manual refresh bypasses the CDN and the in-process cache (?fresh=1)
- background poll every 5 minutes, paused while the tab is hidden, riding the
  edge cache so it usually costs nothing

Five minutes rather than seconds is the point: each real refresh is 12 Nansen
calls, and a tab left open should not drain the key.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

and extracted frames are gitignored.
